title: How Getting Abs Looksmaxxes Your Face
hook: Getting abs makes your face look way better, and I'll prove it to you.
body:
Here's my face when I was 200 pounds. Bloated, puffy, and breaking out. Here's my face now.

Getting lean enough to get abs improves your face in three ways. First, it defines your jawline. You go from a soft, puffy double chin to a jawline you'll want to show off. Second, it sharpens your cheekbones. If your face is round and bloated right now, losing belly fat makes it look more angular and masculine. Third, cleaning up your diet fixes your skin. I was shocked by how much less I broke out after getting lean.

And here's what nobody tells you: your face leans out before your abs show up. You'll see it months before anyone sees a six-pack.
